crossRefs.note: Let all them be shamed who serve engraved images, who boast in their idols. Worship him, all you gods!
The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
There you shall serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
A workman has cast an image, and the goldsmith overlays it with gold, and casts silver chains for it.
He who is too impoverished for such an offering chooses a tree that will not rot. He seeks a skillful workman to set up…
“Those who trust in engraved images, who tell molten images, ‘You are our gods,’ will be turned back. They will be…
Bel bows down. Nebo stoops. Their idols are carried by animals, and on the livestock. The things that you carried…
They stoop and they bow down together. They could not deliver the burden, but they have gone into captivity.
Some pour out gold from the bag, and weigh silver in the balance. They hire a goldsmith, and he makes it a god. They…
They bear it on their shoulder. They carry it, and set it in its place, and it stands there. It cannot move from its…
For the customs of the peoples are vanity; for one cuts a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman…
For this is even from Israel! The workman made it, and it is no God; indeed, the calf of Samaria shall be broken in…
“What value does the engraved image have, that its maker has engraved it; the molten image, even the teacher of lies…
You see and hear that not at Ephesus alone, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul has persuaded and turned away…
When the town clerk had quieted the multitude, he said, “You men of Ephesus, what man is there who doesn’t know that…
What am I saying then? That a thing sacrificed to idols is anything, or that an idol is anything?
But I say that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons, and not to God, and I don’t desire…
